grh_34ca6ce0a7e95fc02ca4.title: Curare
paragraphs: Former star aerialists Benning and Brown come to Dr. Christian with progressive weakness, dizziness and failing grip that have reduced them from the big time to a small circus. He warns them not to perform until the illness is understood, but they go on anyway and one falls from the trapeze. At the ring Dr. Christian notices clown Jojo drop a small bottle and connects it with the performers' rope-burned bare hands. Testing the equipment reveals that their trapeze ropes have been repeatedly dosed with curare, slowly poisoning the men through contact. Jojo confesses that he trained Benning and Brown, then grew bitter when they became stars while an injury ended his own aerial career. His elaborate revenge had been to destroy them gradually while pretending to remain their loyal friend.

The surviving recording runs about 25 minutes. The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.b199d95f77b6c241|Vaseline]].

grh_34929363ee2cdd8ac870.title: Holiday Inn
paragraphs: Jim Hardy leaves show business to create Holiday Inn, a country nightclub open only on holidays, and falls in love with singer Linda. His former partner Ted and a Hollywood director lure Linda toward a screen career, and Jim's jealousy and retreat leave her believing he no longer cares; she reluctantly agrees to marry Ted at Christmas.
